title: H4707 (122nd General Assembly): Firearms

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2018-01-24; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess122_2017-2018/prever/4707_20180124.htm (LegiScan doc 1698805))
provenance.note: Introduced text (Jan. 24, 2018). 'any' struck and 'a' added in places; only 'firearm accessories' is substantively new. Item (2) (landowner discharge) is existing law, not quoted.

operative_text: Section 1 (Section 23-31-510): "No governing body of a county, municipality, or other political subdivision in the State may enact or promulgate a regulation or ordinance that regulates or attempts to regulate: (1) the transfer, ownership, possession, carrying, or transportation of firearms, firearm accessories, ammunition, components of firearms, or a combination of these things;"
